confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of London price levels for July 2026, not from live booking pages or current listings. Restaurant anchors (beer, coffee, meals, wine) are moderately confident. Cocktail and wine are derived from typical London pub and restaurant price relationships to beer where direct knowledge is weaker. Accommodation anchors are the least certain: London hotel and hostel rates vary widely by district and date, and July is peak season, so the hotel figures are wide bounded estimates.
comparable_city_reasoning: Anchored to other high-cost Western European capital cities (for example Paris and Amsterdam) with similar restaurant and accommodation pricing, adjusted for London's notably high hotel rates and its high-cost pub and cafe culture.
